title: Robot Collecting Candies on a Grid
description_html:
You are given a 2D grid containing a robot start position and multiple cells with candies (plus walkable cells and walls). The robot moves one step at a time in the 4 directions and collects a candy when it steps on that cell. Complete the core logic so the robot collects all candies, and return the minimum number of moves to do so (or -1 if impossible).

Grid legend

  • R — robot start  ·  C — candy  ·  . — empty  ·  # — wall

Output

One integer: fewest moves for the robot to collect every candy.

Example

R . C
. # .
C . .
----
6

Candies at (0,2) and (2,0); the wall is at (1,1). Collect one (2 moves), then the other (4 moves) → 6.

Equivalent to LeetCode 864 (keys ≡ candies). See Notes for the state-augmented BFS, the trio, and references.
